page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-standard-192-lssd is a high-capacity, general-purpose virtual machine instance built on the x86_64 architecture. It provides 192 dedicated virtual CPUs and 744.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced distribution of approximately 3.88 GB of RAM per vCPU core. This instance type integrates 16 local NVMe solid-state drives delivering an aggregated local storage capacity of 6,442 GB. It operates without dedicated GPU acceleration hardware and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Designed for parallel processing and high-throughput data access, the dedicated vCPU allocation provides predictable compute performance without interference from neighboring virtual machines. Direct-attached NVMe storage minimizes storage bus latency by keeping large active data sets adjacent to the CPU and memory subsystems, eliminating network hops typical of detached block storage.

From an infrastructure and cost perspective, consolidating 192 cores and substantial local NVMe storage onto a single instance reduces orchestration overhead compared to running multi-node clusters. A critical operational trade-off is the ephemeral nature of the bundled NVMe array; because data stored locally does not persist through machine stop or termination events, architectures require robust replication and snapshotting strategies.

The c4d-standard-192-lssd server is structured to support high-throughput transactional and analytical database systems, distributed caching tiers, in-memory processing engines, and intensive ETL pipelines that require multi-terabyte high-speed scratch space.
description: Google Cloud Platform c4d-standard-192-lssd is an x86_64 general-purpose instance featuring 192 dedicated virtual CPUs and 744.0 GB of memory, maintaining a balanced ratio of roughly 3.88 GB of RAM per core. A key hardware differentiator is the inclusion of 16 local NVMe solid-state drives providing 6,442 GB of high-speed, direct-attached ephemeral storage. The platform does not incorporate GPU accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 networking. Delivering massive parallel compute capacity paired with low-latency local I/O, this instance eliminates storage bus bottlenecks for operations requiring high read/write throughput. By consolidating high core counts, substantial memory, and integrated local storage into a single host, it offers strong resource density for demanding deployments. The c4d-standard-192-lssd is well suited for high-throughput relational and non-relational database engines, distributed caching clusters, big data processing pipelines, and data-intensive enterprise workloads that rely on high-speed scratch space.
